Maruti Suzuki commissions green hydrogen plant in Manesar

Maruti Suzuki India has commissioned its first green hydrogen plant at its Manesar facility in Haryana. The plant has a capacity of 300 kW. This initiative marks the company's move towards sustainable energy solutions.
